questions.question: What was strange about the bubble Mara blew?
options: It popped immediately.
It became as large as a car without popping.
It turned into a frozen ball.
It floated away with her book report.
questions.explanation: 玛拉从糖果店买了新口香糖，吹出的泡泡不断增大，甚至比汽车还大，却始终没有破裂。

questions.question: Why did Mara say she would arrive at the park later?
options: She had to finish her book report.
She had a dentist appointment.
She wanted to visit the candy factory.
She was watching Mighty Man on TV.
questions.explanation: 罗克西告诉朋友们，玛拉要先完成读书报告，所以约好两点在公园会合。

questions.question: Why did the friends begin to worry about Mara?
options: She had forgotten her kickball.
It had started to rain.
The park was closing.
She still had not arrived after another thirty minutes.
questions.explanation: 大家又踢了半小时球，玛拉仍未出现，所以朋友们开始猜测她为何失约。

questions.question: What did Roxy think was the most likely reason Mara was missing?
options: She had been captured by a monster.
She had left Metro City.
She was probably still working on her book report.
She had gone swimming with her parents.
questions.explanation: 其他孩子猜测玛拉遭到外星人或怪物袭击，罗克西则认为她大概还在写读书报告。

questions.question: What did Mayor Bloom report to Rocket Girl?
options: A giant dinosaur was near the school.
A giant pink blob was invading downtown.
The art gallery had lost its paintings.
A robot had stolen City Hall.
questions.explanation: 布卢姆市长联系罗克西，告诉她巨大的粉红色黏块正在侵入市中心，请求火箭女孩处理。

questions.question: What excuse did Roxy give her friends before flying downtown?
options: She needed to buy new shoes.
She was going to the museum.
She had promised to wash more cars.
She was going to look for Mara.
questions.explanation: 罗克西为了赶去阻止粉红色黏块，又要保住身份秘密，就对朋友们说自己去寻找玛拉。

questions.question: What did the giant pink blob remind Roxy of?
options: Bubble gum, both in appearance and smell.
A giant bowl of ice cream.
A cloud made of snow.
A piece of shiny metal.
questions.explanation: 罗克西看到黏块贴着大楼爬行，觉得它看上去像口香糖，而且闻起来也有口香糖的味道。

questions.question: Why was Detective Smith worried about the blob?
options: It was going to eat the police radios.
It had stolen the mayor's watch.
It kept growing and might cover the entire city.
It was turning all cars into toys.
questions.explanation: 探长告诉罗克西，黏块已经存在一个小时并持续扩大，如果不尽快处理，很可能覆盖全城。

questions.question: How did Rocket Girl rescue the bus caught in the blob?
options: She used her heat vision to melt the bus.
She grabbed its bumper and pulled it free.
She called a tow truck from the police station.
She asked everyone to jump out.
questions.explanation: 粉红黏块把公共汽车拖向自己，罗克西迅速抓住保险杠并使劲拉，把巴士从黏块里拽了出来。

questions.question: Who did Rocket Girl discover trapped inside the blob?
options: Detective Smith.
Mayor Bloom.
Terrell.
Mara.
questions.explanation: 罗克西用超强听力听到黏块里有人呼救，绕到另一面后用力把人拉出，发现竟是失踪的玛拉。

questions.question: How did Mara say the giant pink blob began?
options: She spilled a bottle of glue.
She blew a bubble that kept growing.
She opened a broken ice cream box.
She found a meteor in the park.
questions.explanation: 玛拉解释她吹了一个口香糖泡泡，而那个泡泡不断膨胀，最终变成危害城市的巨大黏块。

questions.question: What was the name of the gum Mara had been chewing?
options: Mrs. Wiggles Gum.
Rocket Girl Super Gum.
Metro City Mint Gum.
Giant Bubble Ice Gum.
questions.explanation: 玛拉拿出口香糖包装，告诉罗克西这是名叫Mrs. Wiggles Gum的新产品。

questions.question: What did Mrs. Wiggles demand to stop the blob?
options: A new candy factory.
The city's best television show.
A truckload of ice cream.
One million dollars from Mayor Bloom.
questions.explanation: 维格尔斯夫人威胁，如果市长不给她一百万美元，就让口香糖黏块覆盖整个城市。

questions.question: What did Rocket Girl do when she saw people stuck in the blob?
options: She left them for the police.
She used the blob to catch the villain.
She pulled each person out and carried them to safety.
She threw the blob into the lake.
questions.explanation: 罗克西优先救人，逐个将困在黏块里的人拉出来，再把他们飞送到安全的位置。

questions.question: Why was destroying the giant blob with eye lasers a mistake?
options: The small pieces began moving and growing into new blobs.
It made the city lose all electricity.
It froze the entire street.
It made Mrs. Wiggles disappear.
questions.explanation: 罗克西用激光把巨型口香糖黏块炸成许多小块，但这些小块又开始活动并各自长大，反而加重了危机。

questions.question: What clue helped Mara discover how to stop the blobs?
options: The blobs hated bright sunlight.
The blobs were afraid of water.
A helicopter's cold breeze froze a blob.
The blobs could not climb stairs.
questions.explanation: 玛拉看见一小块黏块跳向直升机时被寒冷气流冻住，因而想到可以利用冷气解决危机。

questions.question: What happened after Rocket Girl used her super breath repeatedly?
options: Every blob froze solid.
The blobs joined into one giant bubble.
All the buildings turned purple.
The blobs floated into space.
questions.explanation: 罗克西按照玛拉的提醒持续用超强呼吸吹出冷风，最终使所有小黏块冻得硬邦邦的。

questions.question: What did Mrs. Wiggles summon when Rocket Girl confronted her at the factory?
options: A group of giant robots.
A swarm of angry bees.
A team of police officers.
Several large gingerbread men.
questions.explanation: 火箭女孩来到糖果工厂要逮捕维格尔斯夫人时，对方打响指召来几个高大凶恶的姜饼人。

questions.question: How did Rocket Girl defeat Mrs. Wiggles's gingerbread guards?
options: She melted them with hot water.
She threw frozen blobs at them until they broke.
She trapped them inside the candy oven.
She told the police to take them away.
questions.explanation: 罗克西离开工厂后返回，用冻住的小黏块不断砸向姜饼人，很快把这些卫兵打碎了。

questions.question: What did Mara tell Roxy's friends about Rocket Girl?
options: She had built a new playground.
She had given Mara a new book.
Rocket Girl saved her from a giant bubble-gum blob.
Rocket Girl helped the soccer team wash cars.
questions.explanation: 回到公园后，玛拉兴奋地告诉朋友们，火箭女孩把她从巨大口香糖黏块中救了出来。

questions.question: What strange sight appeared above West Street early in the morning?
options: A giant pink bubble.
A bright flash of electricity in the dark sky.
A blizzard covering the road.
Two Rocket Girls flying together.
questions.explanation: 清晨垃圾车驶过西街时，天空突然被一道道电光照亮，随后又恢复黑暗，预示异常事件。

questions.question: Why couldn't Mara join her friends at the park the next day?
options: She had a soccer match.
She had to wash cars.
She needed to finish homework.
Her parents had planned a museum visit.
questions.explanation: 玛拉说父母早已安排带她去大都会自然历史博物馆，因此无法按原计划去公园。

questions.question: Why did Terrell wish he could see real living dinosaurs?
options: He knew dinosaurs were extinct and could only see fossils.
He had been invited to a dinosaur farm.
He wanted to make a television show.
He wanted to visit the future.
questions.explanation: 特雷尔希望能看到活着的恐龙，但也知道恐龙早已灭绝，平时只能去博物馆看骨骼化石。

questions.question: Why did Roxy doubt Rocket Girl could help build a time machine?
options: Rocket Girl had never been to the museum.
The time machine was already broken.
She did not think Rocket Girl knew how to build one.
She thought the professor would forbid it.
questions.explanation: 特雷尔想让火箭女孩帮忙造时光机，罗克西觉得这想法不现实，怀疑火箭女孩具备这样的技术。

questions.question: What emergency did Mayor Bloom report?
options: A giant robot had taken the city hall.
Live dinosaurs were roaming downtown Metro City.
The new dinosaur exhibit had been stolen.
The zoo animals were making too much noise.
questions.explanation: 市长告诉罗克西，市中心出现了四处游荡的活恐龙，需要火箭女孩立即前去救援。

questions.question: What happened when two long-necked dinosaurs came down West Street?
options: They helped drivers move traffic.
They destroyed the museum roof.
A frightened car crashed into a store window.
They carried a bus away.
questions.explanation: 两只长颈恐龙在西街行走，一辆汽车试图逃开，结果撞破商店橱窗，司机只能下车逃跑。

questions.question: What did Detective Smith know about the dinosaurs' arrival?
options: The zoo had opened its gates.
Strange electricity lit the sky before the dinosaurs appeared.
The museum brought them on a truck.
Professor Ditto had built them.
questions.explanation: 探长说清晨天空出现奇怪电光，之后恐龙才出现在城市里，但他尚不知道这些恐龙来自哪里。

questions.question: What happened after the small dinosaurs knocked over the hot-dog cart?
options: They ran back to the museum.
They chased Detective Smith.
They flew over the park.
They ate all the fallen hot dogs.
questions.explanation: 一群小恐龙撞翻热狗摊，摊主逃走后，恐龙把掉出来的热狗都吃光了。

questions.question: How did Rocket Girl save the woman threatened by the T. rex?
options: She swept the woman up just before the dinosaur bit.
She froze the T. rex's jaws.
She pushed it into the lake.
She took the woman into the bank.
questions.explanation: 霸王龙张开大嘴要攻击老妇人时，罗克西飞速赶到，在最后一刻把她抱起救走。

questions.question: Why did Rocket Girl become alarmed when the T. rex ran away?
options: It was running toward the art gallery.
It was carrying the mayor.
It was heading along Mountain Street toward the elementary school.
It had stolen a police car.
questions.explanation: 霸王龙离开后沿着通往大都会小学的山街奔跑，罗克西想到孩子们可能遇险，因此再次紧张起来。

questions.question: How did Terrell's feelings about real dinosaurs change?
options: He now wanted to keep a T. rex as a pet.
He was no longer excited after seeing the frightening T. rex.
He wanted to build a larger museum.
He thought dinosaurs were friendly to everyone.
questions.explanation: 特雷尔原本觉得看到活恐龙会很酷，但霸王龙来到学校后，他被吓得不再这样想了。

questions.question: How did Rocket Girl stop the T. rex outside the school?
options: She flew it to the zoo.
She froze its feet.
She hid the students in the basement.
She blasted a deep hole that trapped the dinosaur.
questions.explanation: 罗克西把霸王龙引到球场，用眼睛激光轰出一个大坑，霸王龙踩进去后被困住。

questions.question: Why did Rocket Girl chase the man driving the jeep?
options: He looked suspicious and drove away quickly after seeing her.
He had stolen a school bus.
He was carrying the mayor's money.
He threw a Weather Ball at the school.
questions.explanation: 罗克西注意到戴探险帽的男子看见她就慌张逃走，于是怀疑他和恐龙出现有关，飞起来追踪吉普车。

questions.question: What did Rocket Girl find in the mansion's basement?
options: A hidden diamond mine.
A room filled with television cameras.
A laboratory full of clocks, watches, and calendars.
A pile of stolen dinosaur bones.
questions.explanation: 罗克西循着许多钟表同时滴答的声音进入地下室，发现一间到处都是钟、表和日历的实验室。

questions.question: Why had Professor Flashback brought dinosaurs into Metro City?
options: He wanted to frighten the mayor.
He moved the city millions of years into the past to study living dinosaurs.
He needed help building a museum.
He was testing a robot dinosaur.
questions.explanation: 闪回教授坦言自己想研究活恐龙，所以利用时间旅行装置把整个大都会市送回数百万年前。

questions.question: Why was Rocket Girl worried about the giant clock being damaged?
options: It might trap Metro City in the distant past.
It would stop the school bell.
It might turn the dinosaurs into robots.
It could cover the city in snow.
questions.explanation: 罗克西意识到巨钟控制着城市的时间，一旦钟坏掉，大都会市可能永远被困在过去。

questions.question: What happened when Rocket Girl moved the giant clock's hand to the present?
options: The professor turned into a dinosaur.
The clock began playing music.
The laboratory filled with ice cream.
Electricity flashed and the dinosaurs disappeared.
questions.explanation: 罗克西把巨钟指针转回现在，实验室出现电光，随后城里的恐龙全部消失，表明时间恢复正常。

questions.question: Why did Rocket Girl destroy the giant clock after saving the city?
options: The clock had stopped telling time.
She believed it was too dangerous to leave it working.
The professor had asked her to destroy it.
She needed its metal to fix a car.
questions.explanation: 罗克西用激光摧毁巨钟，是因为她认为它能让整座城市穿越时间，继续使用非常危险。

questions.question: How did Professor Flashback escape after the clock was broken?
options: He hid inside the museum.
He climbed out of a window.
He pressed a button on a golden watch and vanished.
He asked Rocket Girl to take him away.
questions.explanation: 闪回教授卷起袖子露出金表，按下按钮后伴随电光消失，说明他仍有另一件时间旅行装置。

questions.question: Why was the Stone Age cave painting strange to Mara?
options: A caveman appeared to be wearing a hat and using binoculars.
A dinosaur was painted blue.
It showed the school in the present.
All the people in it looked like robots.
questions.explanation: 朋友们在洞穴壁画上发现一个似乎戴帽子、拿望远镜的古代人，但望远镜在石器时代尚未发明，因此玛拉觉得不合理。

questions.question: What happened to the armored truck on West Street?
options: The driver stopped for lunch.
A giant bubble carried it away.
A robot turned it into a toy.
Something suddenly grabbed the truck.
questions.explanation: 押运车在西街行驶时，突然有东西抓住车身，接着车辆失控撞上邮箱。

questions.question: What made the monster-truck show exciting to Roxy's friends?
options: The cars were racing underwater.
The huge noisy trucks had unusual designs, including a gorilla and a shark.
The trucks could travel through time.
Every truck was driven by a superhero.
questions.explanation: 朋友们在竞技场观看的巨型卡车声音响亮、外形奇特，有的像大猩猩，有的带着鲨鱼鳍。

questions.question: What did the Rocket Girl monster truck do after jumping off the dirt ramp?
options: It crashed into a bank.
It became stuck in the mud.
It landed on and crushed a row of old cars.
It picked up a bus with its arms.
questions.explanation: 火箭女孩主题卡车跃过土坡后落到破旧汽车上，车身被压弯、玻璃破碎，引起观众欢呼。

questions.question: Why did Terrell doubt the real Rocket Girl was driving the monster truck?
options: He believed Rocket Girl had more important things to do.
He had seen her at school that morning.
He knew the driver was Detective Smith.
The monster truck was too small for her.
questions.explanation: 特雷尔觉得真正的火箭女孩还有更重要的救援任务，因此不大可能亲自开竞技场的表演卡车。

questions.question: What emergency interrupted Roxy at the monster-truck show?
options: The arena caught fire.
A dinosaur escaped from the museum.
Professor Ditto returned.
An armored truck was robbed on West Street.
questions.explanation: 罗克西手表响起后，市长告诉她西街有押运车被抢，她必须离开观众席处理事件。

questions.question: Why was Roxy worried about the last pretzel being sold?
options: She wanted one for herself.
She had promised to bring Terrell a pretzel.
The snack bar was closing early.
The mayor had asked for a pretzel.
questions.explanation: 罗克西在小吃摊看到最后一个椒盐卷饼被买走，因为特雷尔此前托她带一个，虽然她还有更紧急的任务。

questions.question: What damage on the armored truck suggested how it was attacked?
options: A large hole burned through its roof.
Purple slime covered the wheels.
A dent wrapped around the whole truck like a lasso.
Its windows were frozen solid.
questions.explanation: 罗克西仔细观察押运车，发现凹痕围绕车身一圈，像被套索捆住过一样。

questions.question: What other clue did the guards mention after the crash?
options: They heard a horse.
They saw a robot flying.
They found a candy wrapper.
They noticed a strange clock.
questions.explanation: 守卫说车祸后不仅听到有人喊Yee-ha，还听到了马的声音，进一步暗示抢劫者像牛仔。

questions.question: Who did Rocket Girl identify as the robber?
options: Professor Ditto.
Dr. Odd.
Freddie Freeze.
Stinky Bart.
questions.explanation: 罗克西根据套索痕迹、牛仔的叫喊和马声，认定抢劫押运车的是城里唯一的亡命牛仔臭巴特。

questions.question: What was Rocket Girl's plan for catching the thief?
options: Ask the guards to stop transporting money.
Follow another armored truck and wait for Stinky Bart to attack.
Search all the monster trucks.
Build a giant fence around the bank.
questions.explanation: 罗克西决定跟随另一辆押运车，判断臭巴特迟早还会出手，届时她就能提前准备抓住他。
